## Installation

1. Download and install the [Far Cry Fusion Fix](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#farcry), or the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Fusion Rain Droplets for Far Cry](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/FusionRainDroplets/releases/download/farcry/FarCry.FusionRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` file into the `Bin32` folder. For the 64 bit version of the game, download [the x64 version](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/FusionRainDroplets/releases/download/farcry/FarCry.FusionRainDroplets64.zip) and put its `.asi` file into the `Bin64` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains, outdoors and above the water.

Used Xbox Rain Droplets before? Delete the old `FarCry.XboxRainDroplets.asi` / `FarCry.XboxRainDroplets64.asi`: while it is there, the game shows a message and closes.

## Notes

- Far Cry itself rains only on the multiplayer map mp_airstrip. With **Rain chance in levels** (30% by default, 0 turns it off) any level may rain: whether it does is decided when the level loads, and showers of different strength come and go while it is played. It is the rain of the game itself, so the rain falls in the world as well.
- Water around the camera wets the lens: standing under or next to a waterfall, the spray at its foot, the spray of a boat or a car driven through water, and splashes of things falling into the water, of explosions in it and of bullets hitting it close by. Coming up out of the water covers the lens with it.
- Works with the Direct3D 9 renderer of the game.
- Works together with the Far Cry Fusion Fix; the drops are drawn under the HUD.
- Change the settings on [fusionfix.io](https://fusionfix.io) or in FusionFixHub; changes apply while the game runs. They are stored in the `.cfg` next to the plugin.
